objects.visual_representation: Linear segmented ribbon with labeled 5' and 3' ends, codon blocks, and a distinct upstream Shine-Dalgarno patch for the bacterial example.

scientific_identity.name: small ribosomal subunit (30S, E. coli example)

scientific_properties.function: binds mRNA and anchors via Shine-Dalgarno interaction

objects.visual_representation: Small rounded subunit with an mRNA-binding groove and a labeled rRNA-contact patch.

scientific_identity.name: large ribosomal subunit (50S, E. coli example)

scientific_properties.function: binds tRNAs, contains peptidyl transferase ribozyme

objects.visual_representation: Large rounded subunit with three labeled tRNA sites (A, P, E) and a highlighted peptidyl transferase center.
Combined small and large subunits forming a ribosome with visible A/P/E sites and mRNA threaded between subunits.

scientific_identity.name: initiator tRNA (fMet-tRNA_fMet in E. coli; Met-tRNAi in eukaryotes)

objects.visual_representation: Cloverleaf tRNA with a labeled fMet/Met cargo and an anticodon that pairs with AUG.
Cloverleaf tRNA with an amino-acid cargo and a three-nucleotide anticodon; shown entering A site, shifting to P, then E.

scientific_properties.linkage: linked to P-site tRNA until translocation

objects.visual_representation: Bead-like chain extending from the P-site tRNA, with labeled N and C termini.

scientific_properties.function: recognizes stop codon in A site and triggers release

objects.visual_representation: Distinct protein shape entering the A site when a stop codon is present.
Small helper protein shapes near the small subunit during initiation, labeled generically.

scientific_properties.location: upstream of first AUG in E. coli mRNA
scientific_properties.function: base-pairs with rRNA to anchor 30S subunit

objects.visual_representation: Highlighted AGGAGG patch upstream of AUG with a dashed base-pairing connection to the small subunit.

events.description: Small subunit, mRNA, initiation factors, GTP, and initiator tRNA assemble; initiator tRNA enters P site directly; large subunit joins to form intact ribosome.
events.state_before: Separate small and large subunits; mRNA not fully engaged; no initiator tRNA in P site.
events.state_after: Intact ribosome assembled on mRNA with initiator tRNA in P site and A site free.

events.description: First charged tRNA enters the free A site and its anticodon pairs with the codon after AUG.
events.state_before: A site free; initiator tRNA in P site.
events.state_after: Charged tRNA in A site with anticodon-codon pairing.

events.description: Peptidyl transferase catalyzes bond between A-site amino acid amino group and P-site amino acid carboxyl group; polypeptide remains linked to P-site tRNA until translocation.
events.state_before: A-site tRNA carries one amino acid; P-site tRNA carries initiator amino acid/polypeptide.
events.state_after: Peptide bond formed; growing polypeptide linked to P-site tRNA; A-site tRNA now uncharged or shortened.

events.description: Ribosome advances by three bases in the 3' direction; tRNAs shift from A to P and P to E.
events.state_before: tRNA in A site; peptidyl-tRNA in P site; E site may be empty.
events.state_after: Peptidyl-tRNA in P site; former P-site tRNA in E site; A site free for next charged tRNA.

events.description: Former P-site tRNA in E site detaches from amino acid and is expelled.
events.state_before: Uncharged or detached tRNA in E site.

events.description: Cycle repeats: charged tRNA entry at A site, peptide bond formation, translocation, E-site release.
events.state_before: Peptidyl-tRNA in P site; A site free.
events.state_after: Polypeptide extended by one amino acid; ribosome advanced one codon.

events.description: Stop codon in A site recognized by release factor; polypeptide released; subunits dissociate from mRNA and each other.
events.state_before: Stop codon in A site; peptidyl-tRNA in P site.
